allow_local.doc: Allow local variables when evaluating parameter expressions.

attributes.doc: Repeatable attribute entries with Name, Class, Type, Size, Default, and Value.

domain.doc: Geometry domain receiving the new attribute.

encode_invalid.doc: Encode/sanitize invalid characters in attribute names instead of failing.

existing.doc: Action if attribute already exists: overwrite or keep.

group.doc: Only set it on these elements (others get 0); points or primitives

group_type.doc: Element domain used for group evaluation (guess follows attribute domain).

guess_from_name.doc: Guess attribute type and component size from its name.

name.doc: Name of the attribute to create.

save_to_info_block.doc: Save attribute metadata to node info block.

type.doc: Data type and component count of the new attribute.

value.doc: Value (float/int use the first component; vector4 adds w = 1)

write_values.doc: Write evaluated values to the attribute (false fills default only).
